description: This file defines classes for managing an online quiz in an LMS, including quiz initialization, question rendering, timer management, and result evaluation.

classes.name: Quiz
classes.description: Class for managing quiz lifecycle, rendering questions, handling timer, and submitting responses.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Class representing individual quiz questions, rendering options, and capturing user responses.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches quiz data and renders questions.

methods.name: get_quiz
methods.description: Calls backend to retrieve quiz data.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Initializes quiz UI based on data, including timer and questions.

methods.name: initialiseTimer
methods.description: Sets up countdown timer for the quiz.

methods.name: append_zero
methods.description: Formats time values with leading zero.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits quiz responses and processes results.

methods.name: get_selected
methods.description: Returns selected answer(s) for the question.

methods.name: make_options
methods.description: Creates answer options with input elements.
